title: Structured Cabling Infrastructure
description: Design and execution of the complete structured cabling infrastructure for a 12-floor commercial building — horizontal and vertical backbone to TIA-568, from skeleton to fully certified links.
scope: 12 floors / 480+ user points / MDF + 8 IDF cabinets
roleDetail: Responsibilities covered the full delivery chain: site survey and cable-route planning, horizontal/vertical cable routing, rack and patch-panel termination, labeling scheme design, Fluke certification of every link, and as-built documentation handover.
challenges: Shared ceiling plenum with HVAC and electrical — very limited cable space
Live office environment: installation could not disrupt daily operations
No existing labeling — legacy cabling was undocumented
solutions: Separate cable tray with dedicated bundling per floor to isolate data from power
Night-shift and phase-based rollout, floor by floor, zero business downtime
Uniform labeling scheme (floor/room/port) mirrored in the as-built documentation
results: 480+ links certified on first pass — zero re-terminations
Maintenance and moves/adds/changes now take minutes instead of hours
Documented infrastructure accepted by the client's IT audit without findings

title: Enterprise CCTV Surveillance System
description: Replacement of an aging analog system with a 64-camera IP surveillance platform — camera positioning study, PoE network design, centralized NVR recording and secure remote access.
roleDetail: Owned the project end-to-end: camera coverage study and positioning, PoE switch budgeting, VLAN-separated CCTV network, NVR sizing and RAID configuration, mobile remote-access setup, and staff training.
challenges: Mixed indoor/outdoor conditions including low-light parking areas
CCTV traffic had to be fully isolated from the business LAN
Existing cabling was analog-only and unusable for IP cameras
solutions: Varifocal + IR cameras selected per zone after an on-site light-level survey
Dedicated CCTV VLAN with access rules — zero exposure of cameras to the LAN
New Cat6 horizontal runs to every camera point with PoE from zone switches
results: Security response time dropped from minutes to seconds
Storage engineered for 30 days of continuous H.265 recording
Zero recording downtime since handover — verified by NVR logs

title: Standard Server Room Build
description: From empty room to a bank-grade server room in 6 weeks — rack layout, redundant power, cooling, structured patching and environmental monitoring, delivered to pass the bank's Tier-2 audit.
scope: 4x 42U racks / redundant UPS / precision cooling / monitoring
roleDetail: Responsible for rack placement and elevation design, power distribution with A/B feeds, UPS sizing and installation, cooling airflow planning, vertical cable management, patch-panel termination, labeling and full handover documentation.
challenges: Small room footprint with strict bank clearance requirements
No redundant power path in the original building design
Tight 6-week deadline including audit and sign-off
solutions: 3D rack elevation plan to fit all equipment within clearance rules
A/B PDU power design with automatic transfer between utility and UPS
Weekly milestone tracking with the bank's infrastructure team
results: Passed the bank's Tier-2 audit on first inspection
18 months of operation with zero critical failures
Cable management so clean that routine maintenance needs no external contractor

title: Inter-Building Fiber Optic Backbone
description: Single-mode fiber backbone connecting 5 campus buildings — route survey, duct preparation, fusion splicing, ODF termination and full OTDR certification of every span.
scope: 5 buildings / 2.4 km single-mode fiber / ODF terminations
roleDetail: Performed the duct and route survey, supervised civil preparation, executed fusion splicing and ODF terminations, ran OTDR and insertion-loss tests on every fiber, and delivered the certification report per span.
challenges: Aging ducts with partial blockage along the main campus route
Splicing had to happen outdoors at several manhole points
Strict requirement: every span must test below 0.3 dB loss
solutions: Re-routed two segments through clean spare ducts after a rodding survey
Mobile splicing station with environmental shielding for outdoor work
Bi-directional OTDR testing of every core with per-span certification sheets
results: All 48 cores certified below 0.3 dB per span
Backbone is GPON-ready for future campus expansion
Full OTDR archive delivered as the acceptance baseline
